purpose: Recompute a domain-separated Merkle inclusion root from an entry and explicit sibling path, then compare it with a supplied signed-root receipt.

inputs.proof: leaf index, tree size, and ordered left/right sibling path
inputs.signed_root: root hash, log id, and caller-supplied signature status

outputs.inclusion_report: computed root, binding result, signature uncertainty, and bounded verdict

refusals: invalid leaf index or tree size
